comments.text:
From what you're showing us the lora seems okay, but only if you need a brief shot of somebody's likeness. Otherwise it doesn't seem to cut it if you're doing anything that lasts more than a few seconds. Why? Because it looks like the characters are simply wearing a mask of a face with a fixed expression.

It's one of those uncanny valley things, the characters almost look like the person they're based on, but they only look like an android version of that person who doesn't show natural facial expressions or any emotion other than what was set in the reference image.
Useful for some things I can imagine, but not if you need to focus any amount of time on the character and they need to perform with a range of human emotions.

comments.text:
Im not him buy I got some advice. Comfyui like Nvidia over AMD most optimizations are skewed towards nvidia. However, since you are on 16gb amd you need an amd optimized workflow. 
1. AMD runs better on linux but windows can work just not as good.
2. Ask google to help you run a hipblas + tuningops bat setup and explain how it works to you.(tell them your gpu and system ram specs)
3. Basically on a 16gb card you want to run everything quantized q4 gguf models and everything distilled you can put in it.
4. install crystools node in comfyui manager to monitor ram usage. Anytime your usage goes above 50% you are over the 16gb threshold and comfyui starts dumping/using your slow 32gb ram and that tanks your generation speed significantly.(You will at times go over 50% but if you stay there over most of you run, that is where you get 25min - 1hr.)
5. If you get it optimized you can generate wan 2.2 in under 10 minutes and ltx 20 minutes or under at 960p or lower. You need to oprimize to the maximum to do it with longer videos and 1280p or higher.

Onve you get hipblas and tuning ops working
Your gguf loader kj will be like
dequant type and patch type= float 16
patch on device = true
fp16 accumulation = true
attention overide= sdpa(not sage attention cause its optimized for nvidia)

Try to use tiled vae decodes to prevent oom and optimized speed.
